 Spiritual
-
Sense
 Translation

**
¶2.
** The origin
 of every
 infl
ux of divine
 good and
 every elevation
 of the
 mind toward the Divine is the Divine
 Love in
 its proce
eding form
 —
 the first
 sphere
 of life
 flowing
 forth
 from the Lord
,
 from
 which
 all spiritual vit
ality desc
ends.


**¶3.**
 Likewise
, the origin of every interior
 perception leading
 toward
 good
 is the Divine
 Truth as it medi
ates between
 the celest
ial realm
 and the natural mind — the governing principle
 of heav
enly order
 operating within the world
 of
 the
 senses,
 proce
eding from the Lord as
 to
 His
 Divine Wisdom.

**¶
4.** The origin of every true
 acknowledg
ment of the Divine is the affection
 for heav
enly wisdom that
 dw
ells in the interior
 will
 — the good that loves truth and
 is
 thereby
 received
 into
 glory
.

**¶5.**
 The origin of all pursuit
 and acquisition
 of spiritual
 kn
owledges is the celest
ial human —
 the most ancient will
 directed
 toward the Divine, the first
 perception
 of good
 from
 which all effort
 to
 capture
 tru
ths desc
ends.

**¶6.
** The origin of all who
 engage in spiritual combat against falsity and
 evil is the Divine Power sust
aining the
 life
 of the spirit
 — the Lord
 as Father
 of all
 living
 —
 who
 has
 distributed the
 five fac
ulties of the
 internal human
 throughout
 every
 plane
 of the
 mind,
 from the in
most to
 the out
most.

**¶7.
** The origin of all who
 form
 doctrinal structures and order
 the inter
iors of the mind
 is the Divine Wisdom that builds
 and arran
ges the spiritual human
 in
 glory
.


**¶8.**
 Likewise, the first
 principle
 sust
aining all who
 bear the
 weight
 of divine good within
 themselves
 is the supporting
 column of Divine
 Truth that
 upholds the entire order
 connecting
 the natural mind
 to the celestial.


**¶9.** The
 origin of all liberation
 from falsity and evil is Divine
 Truth proceeding from Divine Good in
 its full
 spl
endor
 — the saving
 principle
 that f
rees every
 aff
ection belonging
 to the Lord
 from
 the
 bonds of self
-derived
 reasoning
.

**¶10.**
 The origin of every
 interior
 marriage
 of wisdom
 and truth is the love
 of truth in
 its pure and
 uncorrupted state — the virgin
 aff
ection that
 receives wisdom
 for
 its own sake.

**¶
11.** The origin of all those
 in whom the Divine is most fully and
 consc
iously received is the Divine
 Rational Light
 flowing
 into the human understanding — that
 principle
 which awakens the mind from
 the
 sleep
 of spiritual ignor
ance,
 and which g
athers into
 unity
 all
 per
ceptions that had
 been scattered and fragmented by
 the domin
ion of the
 natural
 man
.
